train_store: merged (one row per mammogram, union of lesion masks)
mask_merging: merged per mammogram (union of lesion masks)
aug_mask_handling: image and mask stacked on the channel axis, one transform, mask re-thresholded at > 0.5 after rotation
optimizer: Adam (two instances: encoder, decoder), no weight decay
schedule_formula: warm = peak*(step+1)/max(1,warmup_steps); prog = clip((step-warmup_steps)/max(1,total_steps-warmup_steps),0,1); cos = floor + 0.5*(peak-floor)*(1+cos(pi*prog)); lr = warm if step < warmup_steps else cos
two_rate: encoder and decoder on separate Adam instances of the same schedule shape
val_loss_note: computed from WHOLE-IMAGE probabilities on the validation split; run 4's Keras val_loss came from the training graph on PATCHES. The two are not comparable across families. It drives only the secondary checkpoint and never selection.
encoder_bn: trainable, running stats updating (inherent to the encoder)
seed_handling: torch.manual_seed + np.random.seed; the patch plan is a pure function of (seed + epoch); augmentation RNG is default_rng(seed + 100000 + epoch)
